summary: Comprehensive verification of GST Billing Round-Off feature (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_gst_round_off.py with 20 pytest cases — ALL 20 PASSED. Verified: (1) compute_totals exact spec example 10542.36 @18% intra → sub=10542.36, cgst=sgst=948.81, gst=1897.62, total_before_roundoff=12439.98, round_off=+0.02, grand_total=12440.0; (2) negative round_off case (10000.99 → -0.17 → 11801); (3) whole-number case (1000 → 0 → 1180); (4) inter-state case (2x523.45 @12% → IGST=125.63, total_before=1172.53, round_off=+0.47, grand=1173); (5) PUT recomputes round_off on edit; (6) cancelled invoice cannot be edited (400); (7) PDF for NEW invoice contains 'Total Before Round Off' + 'Round Off' + 'Grand Total' lines (decoded via pypdf); (8) PDF for LEGACY invoice (without round_off field) does NOT contain 'Total Before Round Off'; (9) Excel export column 23 header == 'Round Off' and value correctly populated with inv.round_off; (10) GST Report (gstr_report) has 'round_off' column + per-row field + summary.round_off; (11) Other reports daily_sales/monthly_sales/customer_wise/warehouse_wise/payment_wise still 200; (12) tax_summary/hsn_summary/item_wise unchanged (no round_off column); (13) auto-gen invariant gt-tbr==round_off and grand_total is whole rupee; (14) legacy invoices without round_off remain. FRONTEND verified live via Playwright at admin login → /gst-billing: View dialog of TEST_RO_spec (K3/2026-27/0026) shows full breakdown 'Sub Total: Rs.10,542.36 → CGST/SGST → Total Before Round Off: Rs.12,439.98 → Round Off: + Rs.0.02 (green) → Grand Total: Rs.12,440.00 (highlighted)' AND amount-in-words 'Rupees Twelve Thousand Four Hundred Forty Only' (rounded). New Invoice dialog preview strip shows 6 columns including 'Round Off: + Rs. 0.00' alongside Sub Total / CGST / SGST / IGST / Grand Total. Invoice list correctly shows rounded grand totals (12,440.00 / 11,801.00 / 1,173.00). Backward compatibility preserved.
action_items: Optional cleanup: 14 test invoices created during this iteration (TEST_RO_spec, TEST_RO_neg, TEST_RO_zero, TEST_RO_inter, TEST_RO_edit, TEST_RO_cancel, TEST_RO_pdf_new, TEST_RO_excel_known and the two earlier 'Round Off Test'/'Neg Round Off' created by main agent during curl validation). They are all customer_name-prefixed with TEST_RO_ for easy identification. Not blocking; can be left as historical seed data.

Optional: Install pypdf in /app/backend/requirements.txt if the round-off PDF text-content assertion is to be re-run automatically in CI (currently pip-installed transiently in the testing container).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_totals correctly normalizes total_before_roundoff to 2 decimals before rounding to integer grand_total, then derives round_off = grand_total - total_before_roundoff. This avoids float-precision drift.

Backward-compat gating in /app/backend/routes/gst_billing.py uses `if 'round_off' in inv:` (line ~1320) in the PDF builder — exactly the right check (presence-not-truthy) so that legacy invoices with no field render the original 3-row summary while new invoices with round_off=0 still show the extra rows. This matches the JSX gate `viewingInvoice.round_off != null` in GSTBilling.jsx.

Excel export uses `float(inv.get('round_off') or 0)` — note that for new invoices with round_off=0.0 this evaluates to 0 (truthy-falsy edge), which is fine since the user-visible value is also 0. Legacy invoices show 0 in the column. Acceptable.

_build_gst_report adds round_off column and summary.round_off via _round(sum(...)). Sum of round_offs across 14 spec invoices is expected near 0 (+0.02 -0.17 +0 +0.47 + ... ~ small) and the report endpoint returns numeric scalar — verified.

Other report builders (daily_sales, monthly_sales, customer_wise, warehouse_wise, payment_wise) consume invoice.grand_total which is now the rounded integer — sums are now over integers, which is the desired behavior per spec.
tax_summary / hsn_summary / item_wise aggregate at line-item level (taxable, cgst, sgst, igst) which is untouched by round-off — confirmed no 'round_off' column appears in their responses.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (View dialog round-off rows + amount-in-words; New Invoice 6-col preview strip; invoice list rounded grand totals)

seed_data_creation: 14 TEST_RO_* invoices created in /api/gst/invoices during pytest run (intra + inter, positive/negative/zero round_off, one cancelled). Invoice numbers K3/2026-27/0024 through ~K3/2026-27/0034. All have correctly-computed round_off field. Can be safely left or bulk-cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Round-Off feature is complete and stable. Reusable regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_gst_round_off.py (20 cases, ~5s). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/test_gst_round_off.py -v. The TestPdfRoundOff cases require pypdf installed (pip install pypdf). Future iterations: if auto-gen invoice creation flow changes (LPG refill / accessory sale), re-run TestAutoGenInvoiceRoundOff to ensure the round-off invariant (gt-tbr==round_off, gt is integer) holds. Legacy invoices (no round_off field) continue to render correctly in PDF + View dialog — verified live with one legacy invoice in DB.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature implementation verified end-to-end across backend compute, DB persistence, PDF rendering, Excel export, all 10 GST reports, and frontend View/Add/Edit dialogs.
